::: {.hero-text}
# Abhishek Bhattacharjee, PhD {.hero-name}

[Biostatistics leader — clinical development strategy, regulatory science, real-world evidence.]{.hero-role}

::: {.hero-now}
Associate Director, Biostatistics at Pfizer in Chennai, leading a team of
statisticians across therapeutic areas. Before this, primary statistical
reviewer at the FDA's Oncology Center of Excellence. What holds my attention
now are the methods that change what a development program can learn:
real-world evidence, target trial emulation, external control cohorts.
:::
